speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The House had earlier resolved that this Motion and the next Motion appearing on the Order Paper will be debated jointly.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: In response to a clarification by Mr Dennis Tan as to whether the reduced pay comprised both the Minister's pay and MP allowance, the Prime Minister explained that Mr Iswaran's MP allowance was not interdicted, as unlike a Minister's pay, it was not at the discretion of the Prime Minister.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Prime Minister pointed out that it was a matter for Parliament and that Parliament had not done that, nor in previous cases, had it done so.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Instead, what has happened is that the MP has been on leave of absence and, eventually, when the case is settled one way or another, then, consequences will follow.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I believe that it is in this context that the Non-Constituency Member of Parliament (NCMP) Ms Hazel Poa has filed her current Motion.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Indeed, in her Facebook post of 8 September 2023, Ms Poa expressly states that she filed the Motion for Parliament to suspend Mr S Iswaran from the service of Parliament for the remainder of the current session of the 14th Parliament, "so that he no longer receives his MP allowance...".

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: In other words, Mr Speaker – or more accurately, in her own words – Ms Poa is moving a Motion to suspend Mr Iswaran solely in order to cut off his MP allowance.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: We should make decisions on the basis of generally applicable principles and not on individual cases in isolation.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: We are being asked to suspend a Member.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The suspension of an MP is a serious matter.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: If done, it must be done in accordance with the law and on the right principles.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: We need to know on what basis the suspension is sought, what threshold or criterion for suspension the NCMP is relying on and what are the principles that lead Ms Poa to propose suspending Mr Iswaran at this point of time?

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Ms Poa will be speaking in this debate after me and I invite Ms Poa to clarify these matters.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: That is why I have brought the Motion in the terms set out above.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: As lawmakers and elected representatives of our citizens, it goes without saying that MPs should uphold the highest standards of integrity and to conduct ourselves in accordance with the law.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Nevertheless, it is important to signal to Singaporeans that this is what we expect of ourselves so that they have the assurance of knowing that we are committed to this.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: However, we must also be realistic and recognise that there will be occasions when Members may come under investigation for possible wrongdoing, as is currently the case.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The question is, what approach this House should take when that happens.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is dealt with in the second limb of my Motion, which asks the House to affirm that in the event an MP is investigated for possible wrongdoing, we should act in a manner that is not only firm, but also fair.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Again, I do not think that there can be any dispute on this, as a matter of principle and approach.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The real question is how it is to be applied.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Obviously, what is fair will depend on the individual circumstances of each case.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Ms Poa is calling for the suspension of Mr Iswaran.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: What is the principle that Ms Poa is advocating in calling for his suspension?

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: If so, then her proposal should cover all MPs being investigated.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Regarding Mr Singh and Mr Faisal Manap, Members will recall that this House had referred Mr Singh and Mr Faisal Manap to the Public Prosecutor following the outcome of the Committee of Privileges' inquiry into the complaint against Ms Raeesah Khan.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Notwithstanding that they are under investigation, they have not been suspended.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Is Ms Poa calling for their suspension as well?

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This brings us to the third limb of my Motion, which is what we should do with respect to Mr Iswaran at this point in time.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: However, we do not know the facts or what specifically he is being investigated for.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The outcome of the investigation is not yet known.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: We simply do not have sufficient material to make an informed decision at the present time.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It would be better to wait for the outcome of the investigation before deciding what to do.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: That would put us in a better position to assess the right and fair course of action.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: We should not attempt to exploit such situations for political ends, but rather to do the right thing at the right time.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The People's Action Party (PAP) has been very strict with its MPs and Ministers and will continue to be.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I hope Opposition parties will uphold equally high standards – not just in words, but also in deeds.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: In accordance with the decision of this House to take this Motion together with the next Motion standing in the name of Ms Hazel Poa, I will now call on Ms Poa to move her Motion and make her opening speech before allowing Members to debate on both Motions.
